name: SyncIndex
title: Sync Index
description: Make a pack's documents searchable as one index: each cut into chunks with their pages, and embedded where new or changed
whenToUse: Keep a set of documents searchable as one: a fund pack, a deal's files, a policy library. Give it the index's key (the pack's folder) and the pack's documents; it cuts each into chunks with their pages and embeds what is new or changed, so running it twice changes nothing. It builds the index only; asking it a question is a separate step. Documents stay on the platform's own database and are never sent to a third party.

inputs.name: documents
inputs.description: The ids of every document the index holds now, when wired from an upstream node instead of the config

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: What the sync did: { index, documents, added, updated, kept, embedded }

index.title: Index
index.description: The index's key: the address of what owns it, e.g. a fund pack's folder s3://bucket/funds/ROKOS FUND/

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Every document the index holds now, as a list of ids, e.g. return row.content.documents.map(d => d.universal_id). An empty list clears the index.

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: documents
package.packageFile:
# DOCUMENTS — the platform's own document service (services/documents, a Python service beside
# umap): a file in, its structure out. Text in reading order, every table as rows, every figure
# as an image with its caption, every ordered list, the dates a document carries, and where on
# which page each sits. docs/unoverse/data/documents/README.md.
#
# ONE DOOR, ONE NODE: ParseDocument, RenderDocument, InventoryFolder, ReadCover, ReadValues. Each is a JOB on
# the service (start, poll, collect), which is the LlamaParse shape, so the poll capability does
# the waiting. A door does one job, so one can be improved or replaced without touching what
# calls it: a census before reading, a cover before filing, a parse when the whole is wanted.
#
# THE HOST IS THE ENGINE, at loopback (`scope.engineUrl`, :4101), which forwards to the service
# (routes/documents.ts) the way it reaches umap. A node's call must be https or loopback
# (allowedHosts.ts refuses a plaintext request to any other host), and a compose service on the
# Docker network is neither; the engine holds the service's address so no node and no file does.

name: documents
displayName: Documents
description: >-
  Read a file into its structure with the platform's document service. Text, tables as rows,
  figures, lists, dates, provenance
version: 0.1.0
category: ingest
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1751366180/gravity/icons/gravityIcon.png

features:
  - Parse PDF, Word, slides, spreadsheets, HTML and images into one typed structure
  - Tables as rows with units parsed, figures as images, ordered lists as steps
  - Render any page or region as an image
  - "Inventory a folder: kinds, pages, dates, duplicates"
  - "Read a cover: what each file is about and the date it states, from named cells, no model"
  - "Read values: the figures a parsed document stated, refused whole when they do not add up to what it says about itself"

allowedHosts:
  # LOOPBACK ONLY, numeric form (the pattern rejects a bare "localhost"): every call goes to the
  # engine's own listener, which forwards to the service. No third-party host, ever.
  - 127.0.0.1

requires:
  executorVersion: ">=1.6.0"
  transport: [json]
  # Every door is a job: without `poll` an executor would settle on the receipt and emit the job
  # id as the answer.
  poll: true

files.api/events.yaml:
# One row per output connector, in interface.yaml order. `response` is the engine's report.

- emit: report
  value: "return response || {}"
files.api/run.yaml:
# ONE SYNC ON THE PLATFORM'S OWN INDEX, through the engine at loopback (package.yaml says why).
# The engine cuts, embeds and lists; the reply is what it did (docs/unoverse/data/documents/search-index.md).

- name: sync
  method: POST
  url: "return scope.engineUrl + '/index/sync'"
  transport: json

  body:
    index: "{{ config.index }}"
    documents: >-
      return (() => {
        const v = Array.isArray(config.documents) ? config.documents : (signal && Array.isArray(signal.documents) ? signal.documents : []);
        return v.map(d => typeof d === 'string' ? d : (d && (d.universal_id || d.id))).filter(Boolean);
      })()

  # Embedding a long document's pieces the first time is the slow part: a few seconds a document.
  timeoutMs: 600000

  error:
    when: "return !!response.error"
    message: "return response.error"
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [index, documents]
  properties:
    index:
      type: string
      title: Index
      description: >-
        The index's key: the address of what owns it, e.g. a fund pack's folder
        s3://bucket/funds/ROKOS FUND/
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    documents:
      type: string
      title: Documents
      description: >-
        Every document the index holds now, as a list of ids, e.g. return
        row.content.documents.map(d => d.universal_id). An empty list clears the index.
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
"ui:order": [index, documents]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs:
  - name: documents
    type: array
    description: The ids of every document the index holds now, when wired from an upstream node instead of the config
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: report
    type: object
    description: "What the sync did: { index, documents, added, updated, kept, embedded }"

credentials: []
files.node.yaml:
type: SyncIndex
kind: PromiseNode

name: Sync Index
category: Documents
color: "#0F766E"
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1751366180/gravity/icons/gravityIcon.png

description: >-
  Make a pack's documents searchable as one index: each cut into chunks with their pages, and
  embedded where new or changed

# Outcome first, disqualify by PROPERTY, never name another node.
whenToUse: >-
  Keep a set of documents searchable as one: a fund pack, a deal's files, a policy library. Give
  it the index's key (the pack's folder) and the pack's documents; it cuts each into chunks with
  their pages and embeds what is new or changed, so running it twice changes nothing. It builds
  the index only; asking it a question is a separate step. Documents stay on the platform's own
  database and are never sent to a third party.

auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  # A sync writes, so it is never served from memory.
  cacheable: false
files.test.yaml:
# Runs against the platform's own engine and database: syncing a test index with no documents
# embeds nothing and says so. Shape assertions only.
testData:
  config:
    index: "test://sync-index/empty"
    documents: []
  expect:
    report: "return output.report.index === 'test://sync-index/empty' && output.report.documents === 0"
